text:
mari: quick microcopy pass for Console empty states, tooltips, and a couple dialogs. pasted screens.

alex: thx — which empty state are we iterating on?

mari: Routes > Overview when a project has no routes. current copy: "No routes configured. Create a route to start sending requests." Feels generic and a little daunting for new users.

sam: agreed. propose: "No routes yet — create your first route to start sending requests. We9ll show live traffic and usage estimates once it9s active." Sets expectation about what appears after creation.

jess: +1 to expectation. tiny wording nit: "usage estimates" is less scary than "cost estimates". also alt text for the illustration: currently "empty routes illustration" 12; make it more descriptive: "Illustration: dashboard with no routes" for screen readers.

alex: accessibility nit: the "Create a route" link is the only interactive element in the empty state and its color contrast is borderline AA. either increase contrast or add underline. Also ensure the CTA is reachable via keyboard.

ui-bot: tooltip suggestion for the pin icon next to model version. current: "Pin version". Proposal: "Pin model version — lock this route to a specific model version to avoid unexpected changes during rollouts."

sam: nice, shorter would be better: "Pin this route to a model version to prevent automatic updates." Also note: tooltips must appear on focus as well as hover for keyboard/screenreader users.

jess: deploy failure modal: currently header "Deploy failed" and body "Something went wrong." We should show a user-friendly action plus an optional technical detail. Suggest top-level copy: "Deploy failed — we couldn't start the model. Try reducing batch size or try again." Then a "Show details" expandable that reveals the raw error (e.g., "CUDA OOM on host-a").

alex: yeah, technical details behind an affordance. And change retry button text from "Retry" to "Retry deploy" so if dialogs stack it9s clear what action does.

mari: delete route confirmation is too terse. Current: "Are you sure?" Proposed:
Header: "Delete route"
Body: "This will stop traffic to this route and permanently delete its history. This action cannot be undone."
Primary: "Delete route" (destructive)
Secondary: "Cancel"
Conditional: show an "I understand this will stop traffic to this route" checkbox only if route has recent traffic or is tagged production.

sam: checkbox conditional on production/recent traffic — agree, otherwise it slows down simple deletes.

alex: accessibility: ensure the dialog uses role=alertdialog, focuses first interactive control, traps keyboard focus, and supports Escape to cancel. Also link the descriptive text with aria-describedby.

mari: small label tweaks:
- token counter: "Tokens used" -> "Tokens (this request)"
- toast after saving alert rules: "Saved" -> "Alert rule saved"
- generic 500 page: "Something broke" -> "Service error — try refreshing or contact support with error id 500-XYZ" and include a copy button for the id.

jess: tone: keep friendly, active, and actionable. avoid passive voice and vague words like "issue" when we can be specific.

ui-bot: tooltip accessibility checklist: reach via focus, aria-describedby, remain visible while focused, max length ~140 chars, concise action-first language.

mari: no-evals empty state: current: "No evals" Proposed: "No evals run yet — add a prompt set to run quality checks and compare model versions." CTA: "Create eval".

alex: great. mari can you compile a one-page doc with "current -> proposed" lines so I can open a frontend PR? I9ll also include the accessibility notes for QA.

mari: on it, will add copy lines and a short accessibility checklist. Thanks everyone :sparkles!
